title: 2D Contour on a whole model stops where the part grows outward below Top Z (chamfer, slot floor): Bottom Z, step-downs and tabs are dropped with no finding

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

A 2D Contour on a whole model (no picks) takes its ring from the part's section at Top Z and walks it only while the wall it trims stands at the same place (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_depth.rs`). When the part grows outward below that plane - a chamfer, a step, a slot floor - the ring stops there. Bottom Z, the step-down ladder and the tabs below that level are dropped with no note: generate says ok, verify says ok, and the "outside contour" leaves the part attached and its sides unfinished.

Two cases on the same part:

1. **Default Top Z (top_of_model, z 15):** the section at z 15 is the island's top face, so the contour runs **one loop around the island at Z-2 (z 15) only** - no step-downs, nothing on the plate outline, no tabs, though Bottom Z is -0.5 and tab_count 4. (The island widens below z 15 because of its chamfer, so the ring stops at once.)
2. **Top Z = bottom_of_model + 10 (plate top):** the section at z 10 includes the open slot notch. The ring runs Z-7, Z-9, Z-10 (z 10, 8, 7) and stops at the **slot floor** (z 7), where the plate outline closes. The plate sides from z 7 down to -0.5 are never cut and no tab move is written.

## Expected

The outside profile of the part from Top Z down to Bottom Z (-0.5), with the 4 tabs in the bottom 1.5 mm - each level using the part's outline at that level - or, if a ring cannot go deeper, a finding that names the level it stopped at and why (the Prime Directive: mark it incomplete rather than post a silently partial path).

## Repro (MCP)

**Part (p01-flange):** 6061 plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin (z 0..10), a 60 x 30 x 5 mm island on top (z 10..15, R5 corners) with a 1 x 45 deg chamfer on its top edges, 4 x dia 6 through holes at (+-42, +-22), a 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot across the +X end (x 35..45, floor z 7). Stock: box fitted to the model with +2 mm on top (100 x 60 x 17, z 0..17). WCS G54 at the stock's min-X min-Y top corner, world (-50, -30, 17). Machine Tormach 770MX, post Tormach PathPilot.

- `add_tool {catalog: "EM-1000-4FL"}`
- Case 1: `add_operation {kind: "2D Contour", tool: "EM-1000-4FL", source: "flange", params: {bottom_z: {reference: "bottom_of_model", offset: -0.5}, stepdown: 3.5, tab_count: 4}}`, `generate`, `verify`, `post {post: "Tormach PathPilot"}`
- Case 2: same with `top_z: {reference: "bottom_of_model", offset: 10}, stepdown: 2, tab_count: 4, tab_width: 6, tab_height: 1.5`

## Evidence (upstream main abe24ff09)

Case 1 - the whole operation:
```
G0 X83.216 Y11.178 Z0
G1 X83.216 Y11.178 Z-2 F300
G1 X25 Y10.999 Z-2 F1200
G2 X15.999 Y20 Z-2 I0 J9.001
...
G0 X67.225 Y10.655 Z25
```
(X15.999..84.001, Y10.999..49.001 = the island top outline offset by r 5; one level only.)

Case 2 - three levels, deepest Z-10 (world z 7, the slot floor):
```
G1 X89.443 Y-4.801 Z-7 F300   ... loop with the notch G2 X90 Y60 / X95 Y65 ...
G1 X89.443 Y-4.801 Z-9 F300   ...
G1 X89.443 Y-4.801 Z-10 F300  ...
G0 X77.479 Y-5.695 Z25        (end of op)
```
Bottom Z is world -0.5 (WCS Z-17.5). Verify: ok, no finding. The stock in this run has no XY margin, so nothing flags the uncut sides; with real oversized stock the part stays attached.

**Priority P2, not P3:** it does not gouge, but it is the default whole-model 2D Contour silently ignoring a stated Bottom Z and tabs, with no diagnostic anywhere (generate, verify, post) - the op posts a partial program as complete. Not P1 because it removes less, never more.

Found by the QA swarm (SolidCraft v0.44.1 + CamCraft v0.23.0, part p01-flange). Re-checked on upstream main abe24ff09.

**Done means:** on this part both cases contour the plate outline down to Bottom Z with the tabs written (or each ring that cannot go on is refused/flagged by name with the level it stopped at); pinned by tests on a part whose outline grows below Top Z (chamfered island, open-ended slot floor).
